sourceFile: 20. L20S15-07GMI  Report test new bond PT - 7207P( H2 ) and SJ4056 ( H2 ) for process bonding as'y VP + CD_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but misdefines the changed factor and omits key result domains from the validation report.
issues: Changed factor is filename-like, not the actual tested bond/material condition.
Baseline and test conditions are marked unclear despite rows indicating Normal SJ4765 versus PT-7207P/SJ4056 test bonds and laser-CD condition.
Outcome grouping is incomplete; NG separate/function and VP deform results are omitted.
Tension!10 condition text is malformed and row text is not shown in context.
Evidence relies on analysis/tension rows while underusing report rows that define purpose, conditions, and results.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to new bond PT-7207P(H2) and SJ4056(H2) for VP+CD bonding, with Not-use MC laser CD as a secondary condition if supported.
Set baseline as Normal SJ4765 with laser CD use where cited, and changed conditions as PT-7207P(H2) and SJ4056(H2) test lots.
Add outcomes for NG separate, NG function, VP deform, and final function analysis under the same validation context.
Correct Tension!10 parsing to identify SJ4056(H2) as a test condition and cite the full row.
Use Report!6-14, relevant result rows, Report!18/26, and Tension!8/10/12 as primary citations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are not sufficient for final evidence until condition-defining and omitted result rows are cited.
